fix_classes.name: Sibling bases: a member that extends another base defined beside the target, with the same parent (FilterHook/ActionHook in misago/plugins/hooks.py; RalphAPISerializer/RalphAPISaveSerializer), is the same kind on purpose: name both in any_of, or do not propose the single-base rule
fix_classes.overfit: medium: two repos, but Misago's two cards are one root cause (one module, one sibling); ralph is the only independent second case. Must not exempt a member that extends the sibling by mistake (a guard-shaped base stays strict).

fix_classes.name: Resource dependencies are not conventions: a Python call-wrapper rule whose wrapper only provides a resource (a database session or connection: get_db, _get_db_dependency) is incidental; keep call-wrapper rules whose wrapper is a guard (the product's guard_shaped / auth-set notion)
fix_classes.cost: also removes tasking-manager/D-cfe608, labelled ACCEPT (its outliers do need the database), so the subset loses one ACCEPT
fix_classes.overfit: low: a kind-level cut, the Python analogue of D7 keeping guards, not a per-case exemption

fix_classes.name: F3/F4 for decorator rules: a class of another kind in a file named for the followers' kind (SearchForm in forms/search.py among search indexes) or a base type in the module that defines the decorator (NestedGroupObjectType in netbox/graphql/types.py beside register_type) is not about the rule
fix_classes.overfit: HIGH: both cases are netbox; the exemption doc comments already cite netbox's search indexes
